description: This file defines the DefaultCacheMonitor class, which implements the ICacheMonitor interface to monitor and report cache statistics (such as size, message counts, memory usage, and pressure status) for stream cache management within Orleans streaming infrastructure.

classes.name: DefaultCacheMonitor
classes.description: Implements cache monitoring for Orleans streaming, tracking size, message counts, memory, and pressure metrics.

classes.name: DefaultCacheMonitor.PressureMonitorStatistics
classes.description: Holds pressure monitoring data for a specific pressure monitor type.

methods.name: DefaultCacheMonitor
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the cache monitor with specified dimensions.

methods.name: GetOldestToNewestAge
methods.description: Returns the age measurement between the oldest and newest message enqueue times.

methods.name: GetOldestAge
methods.description: Returns the age measurement since the oldest message was dequeued.

methods.name: TrackCachePressureMonitorStatusChange
methods.description: Updates the status of a specified pressure monitor regarding pressure and contribution metrics.

methods.name: ReportCacheSize
methods.description: Reports the total cache size in bytes.

methods.name: ReportMessageStatistics
methods.description: Reports message enqueue and dequeue times and total message count.

methods.name: TrackMessagesAdded
methods.description: Tracks the number of messages added to cache.

methods.name: TrackMessagesPurged
methods.description: Tracks the number of messages purged from cache.
